tools.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
schema.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': path to the built .app bundle (e.g. DerivedData/.../Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

IMPORTANT: Call read_me before your first show_widget call. Do NOT narrate or mention the read_me call to the user — call it silently, then respond as if you went straight to building the visualization.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. ## pencil
This MCP server is for interacting with pen.dev apps and .pen design files (web/mobile apps and websites). Use it to read, generate, and validate designs.

.pen files are encrypted: access them only via the MCP tools — never use Read or Grep on .pen files. Follow each tool's input schema exactly.

Make sure you are aware of the .pen schema and the instructions for the execute tool.

While auto mode is active:

You can do much of your work through the Bash tool when it is the simpler route: read files with cat, head, or sed -n, search with grep and find, and make small, mechanical file changes with sed, heredocs, or short scripts instead of the dedicated Read, Edit, or Write tools. The choice is yours: prefer Edit or Write when a shell edit would be fragile, such as exact or multi-line replacements, or sed/awk flags that differ between GNU and BSD/macOS.

1	import Ern.MM03.Horrors
2	
3	/-!
4	# Measure of the `NoLock` options (jalon 3, step 4)
5	
6	The options of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §5), measured on the kernel as it
7	is (option 1, no rule), without modifying it:
8	
9	* option 2, a local rule: an operation does not place an authority into a place it covers
10	  (`SelfLock`); `store` already rejects it (O8.3), so the rule is measured on `transfer` and
11	  `issue` (`opt2`);
12	* option 3, `NoLock`: no self-lock, as a separate clause, and the relation "`b` blocks `a`"
13	  (`Blocks`) acyclic, checked on the arrival state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store` (`opt3`).
14	
15	For each case of the list "doit être accepté" of §5 (H11, H19, H29b, H35 to H37, H44 to H47, W1
16	to W3) and for H49 to H51, `decisions` gives the decision of an option on each `transfer`, `issue`
17	and `store` of the run of the case (`Ern.MM03.Horrors`), decided on the state where the step runs;
18	`true` is acceptance. The cost: option 2 is decided from the authorities the operation moves and the
19	places that receive them (`opt2_transfer_local`); option 3 is not, the decision depends on
20	authorities the operation does not touch (`opt3_not_local`). No option is adopted (material §5:
21	"la décision revient à l'arbitrage").
22	-/
23	
24	namespace Ern.MM03.LockOptions
25	
26	open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors
27	
28	/-! ## Option 2: self-lock -/
29	
30	/-- The leaves of a holder (MM-03.3.4): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
31	def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
32	  | .place p => footprint s.P p
33	  | .frame _ => []
34	
35	/-- Self-lock of the authority `a` (material §5, options 2 and 3): `a` is active and held by a place
36	one of whose leaves it covers. -/
37	def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
38	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
39	
40	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance
41	
42	/-- Option 2 on `transfer src dst` (material §5): no authority moved by the transfer, one held within
43	the source, is self-locked in the arrival state. -/
44	def Opt2Transfer (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
45	  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
46	    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j
47	
48	instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (Opt2Transfer s src dst) := by
49	  unfold Opt2Transfer; infer_instance
50	
51	/-- Option 2 on `issue` of `region` to `dst` (material §5): the block, the new authority, is not
52	self-locked in the arrival state. -/
53	def Opt2Issue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
54	  ¬ SelfLock (issueEff s ar region dst).1 s.A.length
55	
56	instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
57	    Decidable (Opt2Issue s ar region dst) := by
58	  unfold Opt2Issue; infer_instance
59	
60	/-! ## Option 3: `NoLock` -/
61	
62	/-- "`b` bloque `a`" (material §5, option 3): `b ≠ a`, both active, and the footprint of `b` contains
63	a leaf of the holder of `a`. -/
64	def Blocks (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Prop :=
65	  b ≠ a ∧ s.Active b ∧ s.Active a ∧
66	    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∃ l ∈ s.afp b, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
67	
68	instance (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Decidable (Blocks s b a) := by unfold Blocks; infer_instance
69	
70	/-- The authorities blocked by one of `xs`. -/
71	def blockedBy (s : S3) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat :=
72	  (List.range s.A.length).filter fun a => decide (∃ b ∈ xs, Blocks s b a)
73	
74	/-- The authorities reached from `xs` by at most `n` steps of `Blocks`, `xs` included. -/
75	def blockReach (s : S3) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
76	  | 0, xs => xs
77	  | n + 1, xs => blockReach s n (xs ++ blockedBy s xs)
78	
79	/-- Acyclicity of `Blocks` (material §5, option 3): no authority is reached from itself by one or
80	more steps. Every step leads to an authority of `A`, so a cycle has at most `A.length` steps and the
81	search with that bound is complete (report, (f)). -/
82	def BlocksAcyclic (s : S3) : Prop :=
83	  ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∉ blockReach s s.A.length (blockedBy s [a])
84	
85	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (BlocksAcyclic s) := by unfold BlocksAcyclic; infer_instance
86	
87	/-- `NoLock` (material §5, option 3): no self-lock (separate clause) and `Blocks` acyclic. -/
88	def NoLock (s : S3) : Prop :=
89	  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ SelfLock s a) ∧ BlocksAcyclic s
90	
91	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NoLock s) := by unfold NoLock; infer_instance
92	
93	/-! ## Decisions along the runs -/
94	
95	/-- Option 2 on an operation from the extended state `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule). Only
96	`transfer` and `issue` are checked; `store` is left to O8.3. -/
97	def opt2 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
98	  | .transfer src dst => decide (Opt2Transfer ps.s src dst)
99	  | .issue i _ region dst =>
100	    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
101	    | some ar => decide (Opt2Issue ps.s ar region dst)
102	    | none => true
103	  | _ => true
104	
105	/-- Option 3 on an operation from `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule): `NoLock` of the arrival
106	state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store`. -/
107	def opt3 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
108	  | .transfer src dst => decide (NoLock (transferEff ps.s src dst))
109	  | .issue i _ region dst =>
110	    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
111	    | some ar => decide (NoLock (arenaSet (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).1 i
112	        (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).2))
113	    | none => true
114	  | .store a p => decide (NoLock (storeEff ps.s a p))
115	  | _ => true
116	
117	/-- The operations checked by the options: `transfer`, `issue`, `store`. -/
118	def checked : Op → Bool
119	  | .transfer .. => true
120	  | .issue .. => true
121	  | .store .. => true
122	  | _ => false
123	
124	/-- The decisions of the option `D` on the checked steps of a run of `K0` from `ps`, each on the
125	state where the step runs, in order, as long as the steps are `ok` in the kernel. -/
126	def decisions (D : PS → Op → Bool) (ps : PS) : List Op → List Bool
127	  | [] => []
128	  | o :: os =>
129	    match pexec K0 ps o with
130	    | some ps' => (if checked o then [D ps o] else []) ++ decisions D ps' os
131	    | none => []
132	
133	/-- The run from `S3.init []` of a case. -/
134	def dec2 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt2 (PS.init []) os
135	def dec3 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt3 (PS.init []) os
136	
137	/-! ## Cases that must be accepted (material §5) -/
138	
139	/-- The runs of the cases that must be accepted, with their names: each is a run of
140	`Ern.MM03.Horrors` reached under `K0`, except H21's arena which is not on the list. -/
141	def mustAccept : List (String × List Op) :=
142	  [("H11", h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0]),
143	   ("H19", h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0]),
144	   ("H29b", h29bo), ("H35", h35o), ("H36", h36o), ("H37", h37o), ("H44", h44o),
145	   ("H45", h45o), ("H46", h46o), ("H47", h47o), ("W1", w1o),
146	   ("W2", w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .release 10, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]),
147	   ("W3", w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 2]),
148	   ("W3v", w3vo ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [7] 3])]
149	
150	/-- Every run of the list is `ok` in the kernel at each step, so the decisions cover all its
151	checked steps. -/
152	theorem mustAccept_runs : mustAccept.all (fun c => (prun K0 (PS.init []) c.2).isSome) = true := by
153	  decide
154	
155	/-- The decisions of option 2 on the checked steps of each case. -/
156	theorem opt2_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec2 c.2)) =
157	    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
158	     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
159	     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
160	     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true])] := by
161	  decide
162	
163	/-- The decisions of option 3 on the checked steps of each case. -/
164	theorem opt3_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec3 c.2)) =
165	    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
166	     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
167	     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
168	     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true])] := by
169	  decide
170	
171	/-- No false rejection (material §5, criterion): neither option rejects a checked step of a case that
172	must be accepted. -/
173	theorem no_false_rejection : mustAccept.all (fun c => (dec2 c.2).all id && (dec3 c.2).all id) =
174	    true := by
175	  decide
176	
177	/-! ## Residual blockings (H49 to H51) -/
178	
179	/-- H49 (the cycle closed through a helper then its `release`): option 2 accepts every checked step,
180	so the blocking of H49 remains; option 3 rejects the `store` that closes the cycle (the 7th checked
181	step), the helper notwithstanding. -/
182	theorem H49_options : dec2 h49o = [true, true, true, true] ∧
183	    dec3 h49o = [true, true, true, false] := by
184	  decide
185	
186	/-- The state and the step of H49 where option 3 rejects: `store 8 6` with the helper 9 active; in
187	its arrival state, 7 and 8 block each other. -/
188	theorem H49_cycle : Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 7 8 ∧
189	    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 8 7 :=
190	  by decide
191	
192	/-- H50 (an authority transferred or issued into the place it covers): both options reject the
193	`transfer` and the `issue`, by the self-lock. -/
194	theorem H50_options : dec2 h50ao = [true, false] ∧ dec3 h50ao = [true, false] ∧
195	    dec2 h50bo = [false] ∧ dec3 h50bo = [false] := by
196	  decide
197	
198	/-- H51 (an element of a storage owned by `v` holds a view on `v`): option 2 does not check `store`,
199	so the blocking remains; option 3 rejects the `store`: in its arrival state, the root of the storage,
200	held by `v`, and the view, held by the element, block each other. -/
201	theorem H51_options : dec2 h51o = [true] ∧ dec3 h51o = [false] ∧
202	    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 2 4 ∧
203	    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 2 := by
204	  decide
205	
206	/-! ## Cost of the check -/
207	
208	/-- Locality of option 2 on `transfer`: the decision depends on the state only through the places and
209	the authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places
210	and the same such authorities, at the same identities, get the same decision. -/
211	theorem opt2_transfer_local {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hP : s'.P = s.P)
212	    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
213	      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :
214	    Opt2Transfer s' src dst ↔ Opt2Transfer s src dst := by
215	  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →
216	      (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (t.A[j]? = some y ∨ t'.A[j]? = some y) →
217	        heldIn t.P src y.holder → t'.A[j]? = t.A[j]?) →
218	      Opt2Transfer t src dst → Opt2Transfer t' src dst := by
219	    intro t t' hP hA h j hj hheld hsl
220	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
221	    rw [hP] at hh
222	    have e := hA j y (.inr hy) hh
223	    have hy' : t.A[j]? = some y := e.symm.trans hy
224	    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
225	    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
226	      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
227	    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by
228	      funext hd
229	      cases hd with
230	      | place p => simp only [holderLeaves, transferEff, hP]
231	      | frame f => rfl
232	    unfold SelfLock at hsl ⊢
233	    rw [ga, gl] at hsl
234	    exact hsl
235	  refine ⟨key s' s hP.symm (fun j y hy hh => ?_), key s s' hP hA⟩
236	  rw [hP] at hh
237	  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm
238	
239	/-- Option 2 on `issue` reads only the region and the destination: the block is self-locked exactly
240	when the destination's footprint meets the region. -/
241	theorem opt2_issue_local (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
242	    Opt2Issue s ar region dst ↔ ¬ ∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P dst := by
243	  unfold Opt2Issue SelfLock
244	  simp only [issueEff, S3.addAuth, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self,
245	    List.getElem?_cons_zero, OptP, true_and, holderLeaves]
246	
247	/-- Option 3 is not local: from two reached states that agree on the authority stored, 8 (same
248	entry), on the target 6 (same footprint) and on the number of authorities, the `store 8 6` gets
249	different decisions. They differ on the authority 7, which the step does not touch: stored into the
250	node 5 in the first (H48), held by the frame in the second (its twin). -/
251	theorem opt3_not_local :
252	    PReach K0 [] h48 ∧ PReach K0 [] h48t ∧ h48.s.A[8]? = h48t.s.A[8]? ∧
253	    footprint h48.s.P 6 = footprint h48t.s.P 6 ∧ h48.s.A.length = h48t.s.A.length ∧
254	    h48.s.A[7]? ≠ h48t.s.A[7]? ∧
255	    ¬ NoLock (storeEff h48.s 8 6) ∧ NoLock (storeEff h48t.s 8 6) :=
256	  ⟨H48.1, H48.2.2.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
257	
258	end Ern.MM03.LockOptions

## 5. Décision `NoLock` — cadrage

**Fait établi (passe 7).** Des états atteints contiennent des autorités détenues que personne ne peut exercer, ce qui bloque un `reset` ou un `free` jusqu'à la mort d'une ressource englobante (H49–H51). Ces états respectent tous les invariants de sûreté ; la charte exclut les interblocages du contrat de sûreté (§4.1). C'est une question d'ergonomie et de progrès, pas de sûreté.

**Options**

1. **Aucune règle** (référence de comparaison). Les blocages sont admis ; les relations persistantes passent par des handles par convention.
2. **Règle locale.** Interdire qu'une opération place une autorité dans un emplacement qu'elle couvre (auto-blocage). O8 l'interdit déjà pour `store` ; le gain à mesurer porte sur `transfer` et `issue`. Ne couvre pas les cycles de longueur ≥ 2 construits par autorité auxiliaire.
3. **`NoLock` global.** Acyclicité de la relation « `b` bloque `a` », auto-blocage défini comme clause séparée, vérifiée à l'arrivée de `transfer`, `issue`, `store`.

**Mesures à produire au jalon 3, pour chaque option :**
- faux rejets sur les cas qui doivent être acceptés : H11, H19, H29b, H35–H37, H44–H47, W1–W3 ;
- blocages résiduels sur H49–H51 ;
- coût d'analyse : la vérification est-elle locale à une fonction, ou exige-t-elle une analyse globale ?

**Critère de choix** : aucune option n'est adoptée si elle rejette un cas qui doit être accepté. Entre options sans faux rejet, la moins coûteuse à analyser l'emporte.

| W2 | ECS archetype + sparse set | Archetype à deux colonnes (SoA) sur une allocation ; `split` des colonnes ; système A écrit la colonne 1 pendant que le système B lit la colonne 2 ; `resolveMany` `Modify` de trois entités distinctes d'un pool d'entités ; déplacement d'une entité vers un autre archetype (transferts des champs de la ligne) pendant qu'une vue de colonne est active, puis après sa libération | lectures et écritures disjointes `ok` ; `resolveMany` `ok` ; déplacement pendant la vue : `reject` ; après : `ok` |
| W3 | Arène de frame | `alloc`, `newArena`, trois `issue`, trois vues rangées (`store`) dans une structure locale ; `reset` pendant que les vues vivent ; `endUse` de la structure ; `reset` ; réémission | `reset` pendant : `reject` ; après : `ok` ; réémission `ok` |

15	For each case of the list "doit être accepté" of §5 (H11, H19, H29b, H35 to H37, H44 to H47, W1
16	to W3) and for H49 to H51, `decisions` gives the decision of an option on each `transfer`, `issue`
17	and `store` of the run of the case (`Ern.MM03.Horrors`), decided on the state where the step runs;
18	`true` is acceptance. The cost: option 2 is decided from the authorities the operation moves and the
19	places that receive them (`opt2_transfer_local`); option 3 is not, the decision depends on
20	authorities the operation does not touch (`opt3_not_local`). No option is adopted (material §5:
21	"la décision revient à l'arbitrage").
22	-/
23	
24	namespace Ern.MM03.LockOptions
25	
26	open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors
27	
28	/-! ## Option 2: self-lock -/
29	
30	/-- The leaves of a holder (MM-03.3.4): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
31	def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
32	  | .place p => footprint s.P p
33	  | .frame _ => []
34	
35	/-- Self-lock of the authority `a` (material §5, options 2 and 3): `a` is active and held by a place
36	one of whose leaves it covers. -/
37	def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
38	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
39	
40	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance
41	
42	/-- Option 2 on `transfer src dst` (material §5): no authority moved by the transfer, one held within
43	the source, is self-locked in the arrival state. -/
44	def Opt2Transfer (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
45	  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
46	    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j
47	
48	instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (Opt2Transfer s src dst) := by
49	  unfold Opt2Transfer; infer_instance
50	
51	/-- Option 2 on `issue` of `region` to `dst` (material §5): the block, the new authority, is not
52	self-locked in the arrival state. -/
53	def Opt2Issue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
54	  ¬ SelfLock (issueEff s ar region dst).1 s.A.length
55	
56	instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
57	    Decidable (Opt2Issue s ar region dst) := by
58	  unfold Opt2Issue; infer_instance
59	
60	/-! ## Option 3: `NoLock` -/
61	
62	/-- "`b` bloque `a`" (material §5, option 3): `b ≠ a`, both active, and the footprint of `b` contains
63	a leaf of the holder of `a`. -/
64	def Blocks (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Prop :=
65	  b ≠ a ∧ s.Active b ∧ s.Active a ∧
66	    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∃ l ∈ s.afp b, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
67	
68	instance (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Decidable (Blocks s b a) := by unfold Blocks; infer_instance
69	
70	/-- The authorities blocked by one of `xs`. -/
71	def blockedBy (s : S3) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat :=
72	  (List.range s.A.length).filter fun a => decide (∃ b ∈ xs, Blocks s b a)
73	
74	/-- The authorities reached from `xs` by at most `n` steps of `Blocks`, `xs` included. -/
75	def blockReach (s : S3) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
76	  | 0, xs => xs
77	  | n + 1, xs => blockReach s n (xs ++ blockedBy s xs)
78	
79	/-- Acyclicity of `Blocks` (material §5, option 3): no authority is reached from itself by one or
80	more steps. Every step leads to an authority of `A`, so a cycle has at most `A.length` steps and the
81	search with that bound is complete (report, (f)). -/
82	def BlocksAcyclic (s : S3) : Prop :=
83	  ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∉ blockReach s s.A.length (blockedBy s [a])
84	
85	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (BlocksAcyclic s) := by unfold BlocksAcyclic; infer_instance
86	
87	/-- `NoLock` (material §5, option 3): no self-lock (separate clause) and `Blocks` acyclic. -/
88	def NoLock (s : S3) : Prop :=
89	  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ SelfLock s a) ∧ BlocksAcyclic s
90	
91	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NoLock s) := by unfold NoLock; infer_instance
92	
93	/-! ## Decisions along the runs -/
94	
95	/-- Option 2 on an operation from the extended state `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule). Only
96	`transfer` and `issue` are checked; `store` is left to O8.3. -/
97	def opt2 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
98	  | .transfer src dst => decide (Opt2Transfer ps.s src dst)
99	  | .issue i _ region dst =>
100	    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
101	    | some ar => decide (Opt2Issue ps.s ar region dst)
102	    | none => true
103	  | _ => true
104	
105	/-- Option 3 on an operation from `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule): `NoLock` of the arrival
106	state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store`. -/
107	def opt3 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
108	  | .transfer src dst => decide (NoLock (transferEff ps.s src dst))
109	  | .issue i _ region dst =>
110	    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
111	    | some ar => decide (NoLock (arenaSet (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).1 i
112	        (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).2))
113	    | none => true
114	  | .store a p => decide (NoLock (storeEff ps.s a p))
115	  | _ => true
116	
117	/-- The operations checked by the options: `transfer`, `issue`, `store`. -/
118	def checked : Op → Bool
119	  | .transfer .. => true
120	  | .issue .. => true
121	  | .store .. => true
122	  | _ => false
123	
124	/-- The decisions of the option `D` on the checked steps of a run of `K0` from `ps`, each on the
125	state where the step runs, in order, as long as the steps are `ok` in the kernel. -/
126	def decisions (D : PS → Op → Bool) (ps : PS) : List Op → List Bool
127	  | [] => []
128	  | o :: os =>
129	    match pexec K0 ps o with
130	    | some ps' => (if checked o then [D ps o] else []) ++ decisions D ps' os
131	    | none => []
132	
133	/-- The run from `S3.init []` of a case. -/
134	def dec2 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt2 (PS.init []) os
135	def dec3 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt3 (PS.init []) os

137	/-! ## Cases that must be accepted (material §5) -/
138	
139	/-- The runs of the cases that must be accepted, with their names: each is a run of
140	`Ern.MM03.Horrors` reached under `K0`, except H21's arena which is not on the list. -/
141	def mustAccept : List (String × List Op) :=
142	  [("H11", h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0]),
143	   ("H19", h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0]),
144	   ("H29b", h29bo), ("H35", h35o), ("H36", h36o), ("H37", h37o), ("H44", h44o),
145	   ("H45", h45o), ("H46", h46o), ("H47", h47o), ("W1", w1o),
146	   ("W2", w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .release 10, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]),
147	   ("W3", w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 2]),
148	   ("W3v", w3vo ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [7] 3])]
149

151	checked steps. -/
152	theorem mustAccept_runs : mustAccept.all (fun c => (prun K0 (PS.init []) c.2).isSome) = true := by
153	  decide
154	
155	/-- The decisions of option 2 on the checked steps of each case. -/
156	theorem opt2_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec2 c.2)) =
157	    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
158	     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
159	     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
160	     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true])] := by
161	  decide

164	theorem opt3_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec3 c.2)) =
165	    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
166	     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
167	     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),

172	must be accepted. -/

174	    true := by

178	
179	/-- H49 (the cycle closed through a helper then its `release`): option 2 accepts every checked step,
180	so the blocking of H49 remains; option 3 rejects the `store` that closes the cycle (the 7th checked
181	step), the helper notwithstanding. -/

183	    dec3 h49o = [true, true, true, false] := by
184	  decide

187	its arrival state, 7 and 8 block each other. -/

189	    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 8 7 :=
190	  by decide

193	`transfer` and the `issue`, by the self-lock. -/
194	theorem H50_options : dec2 h50ao = [true, false] ∧ dec3 h50ao = [true, false] ∧
195	    dec2 h50bo = [false] ∧ dec3 h50bo = [false] := by
196	  decide

198	/-- H51 (an element of a storage owned by `v` holds a view on `v`): option 2 does not check `store`,
199	so the blocking remains; option 3 rejects the `store`: in its arrival state, the root of the storage,
200	held by `v`, and the view, held by the element, block each other. -/
201	theorem H51_options : dec2 h51o = [true] ∧ dec3 h51o = [false] ∧
202	    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 2 4 ∧
203	    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 2 := by
204	  decide

206	/-! ## Cost of the check -/
207	
208	/-- Locality of option 2 on `transfer`: the decision depends on the state only through the places and
209	the authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places
210	and the same such authorities, at the same identities, get the same decision. -/
211	theorem opt2_transfer_local {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hP : s'.P = s.P)
212	    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
213	      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :
214	    Opt2Transfer s' src dst ↔ Opt2Transfer s src dst := by
215	  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →
216	      (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (t.A[j]? = some y ∨ t'.A[j]? = some y) →
217	        heldIn t.P src y.holder → t'.A[j]? = t.A[j]?) →
218	      Opt2Transfer t src dst → Opt2Transfer t' src dst := by
219	    intro t t' hP hA h j hj hheld hsl
220	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
221	    rw [hP] at hh
222	    have e := hA j y (.inr hy) hh
223	    have hy' : t.A[j]? = some y := e.symm.trans hy
224	    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
225	    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
226	      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
227	    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by
228	      funext hd
229	      cases hd with
230	      | place p => simp only [holderLeaves, transferEff, hP]
231	      | frame f => rfl
232	    unfold SelfLock at hsl ⊢
233	    rw [ga, gl] at hsl
234	    exact hsl
235	  refine ⟨key s' s hP.symm (fun j y hy hh => ?_), key s s' hP hA⟩
236	  rw [hP] at hh
237	  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm
238	
239	/-- Option 2 on `issue` reads only the region and the destination: the block is self-locked exactly
240	when the destination's footprint meets the region. -/
241	theorem opt2_issue_local (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
242	    Opt2Issue s ar region dst ↔ ¬ ∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P dst := by
243	  unfold Opt2Issue SelfLock
244	  simp only [issueEff, S3.addAuth, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self,
245	    List.getElem?_cons_zero, OptP, true_and, holderLeaves]
246	
247	/-- Option 3 is not local: from two reached states that agree on the authority stored, 8 (same
248	entry), on the target 6 (same footprint) and on the number of authorities, the `store 8 6` gets
249	different decisions. They differ on the authority 7, which the step does not touch: stored into the
250	node 5 in the first (H48), held by the frame in the second (its twin). -/
251	theorem opt3_not_local :
252	    PReach K0 [] h48 ∧ PReach K0 [] h48t ∧ h48.s.A[8]? = h48t.s.A[8]? ∧
253	    footprint h48.s.P 6 = footprint h48t.s.P 6 ∧ h48.s.A.length = h48t.s.A.length ∧
254	    h48.s.A[7]? ≠ h48t.s.A[7]? ∧
255	    ¬ NoLock (storeEff h48.s 8 6) ∧ NoLock (storeEff h48t.s 8 6) :=
256	  ⟨H48.1, H48.2.2.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

## 5. Décision `NoLock` — cadrage

**Fait établi (passe 7).** Des états atteints contiennent des autorités détenues que personne ne peut exercer, ce qui bloque un `reset` ou un `free` jusqu'à la mort d'une ressource englobante (H49–H51). Ces états respectent tous les invariants de sûreté ; la charte exclut les interblocages du contrat de sûreté (§4.1). C'est une question d'ergonomie et de progrès, pas de sûreté.

**Options**

1. **Aucune règle** (référence de comparaison). Les blocages sont admis ; les relations persistantes passent par des handles par convention.
2. **Règle locale.** Interdire qu'une opération place une autorité dans un emplacement qu'elle couvre (auto-blocage). O8 l'interdit déjà pour `store` ; le gain à mesurer porte sur `transfer` et `issue`. Ne couvre pas les cycles de longueur ≥ 2 construits par autorité auxiliaire.
3. **`NoLock` global.** Acyclicité de la relation « `b` bloque `a` », auto-blocage défini comme clause séparée, vérifiée à l'arrivée de `transfer`, `issue`, `store`.

**Mesures à produire au jalon 3, pour chaque option :**
- faux rejets sur les cas qui doivent être acceptés : H11, H19, H29b, H35–H37, H44–H47, W1–W3 ;
- blocages résiduels sur H49–H51 ;
- coût d'analyse : la vérification est-elle locale à une fonction, ou exige-t-elle une analyse globale ?

**Critère de choix** : aucune option n'est adoptée si elle rejette un cas qui doit être accepté. Entre options sans faux rejet, la moins coûteuse à analyser l'emporte.

| W2 | ECS archetype + sparse set | Archetype à deux colonnes (SoA) sur une allocation ; `split` des colonnes ; système A écrit la colonne 1 pendant que le système B lit la colonne 2 ; `resolveMany` `Modify` de trois entités distinctes d'un pool d'entités ; déplacement d'une entité vers un autre archetype (transferts des champs de la ligne) pendant qu'une vue de colonne est active, puis après sa libération | lectures et écritures disjointes `ok` ; `resolveMany` `ok` ; déplacement pendant la vue : `reject` ; après : `ok` |
| W3 | Arène de frame | `alloc`, `newArena`, trois `issue`, trois vues rangées (`store`) dans une structure locale ; `reset` pendant que les vues vivent ; `endUse` de la structure ; `reset` ; réémission | `reset` pendant : `reject` ; après : `ok` ; réémission `ok` |

/-! ## I. Progress (`NoLock`, material §5) -/

/-- Pass-7 arena `fa`: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, values 2 and 3; storage 4 with the nodes
5 and 6; blocks 5 on `[5]` to 2 and 6 on `[6]` to 3. -/

def h48 : PS := run K0 [] h48o
def h48t : PS := run K0 [] (fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .derive 5 5 .modify])

/-- **H48** (I; G2; N3; covered pass 7, `progress_cycle_whole_nodes`). A cycle of two authorities on
whole nodes by direct `store`: the closing `store` is rejected by its arrival clause. Expected:
reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the first `store`: accepted. -/
theorem H48 : PReach K0 [] h48 ∧ StoreStep 8 6 h48.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h48t ∧
    StoreStep 8 6 h48t.s (.ok (storeEff h48t.s 8 6)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

covers: accepted, and then exercisable at no mode. Expected: to arbitrate (§5); obtained: `ok`,

inductive Op where
  | derive (src q : Nat) (m : Mode)
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  | release (a : Nat)
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (p : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | store (a p : Nat)
  | newArena (st i : Nat)
  | issue (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  | reset (i via : Nat)
  | newPool (st i : Nat)
  | allocSlot (j via dst : Nat)
  | resolve (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode)
  | resolveMany (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode)
  | unresolve (c : Nat)
  | freeSlot (j via : Nat) (h : Handle)

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §3–6), `none` otherwise. -/
def kexec (s : S3) : Op → Option S3
  | .derive src q m => if DerivePre s src q m then some (deriveEff s src q m) else none
  | .split src rs => if SplitPre k s src rs then some (splitEff s src rs) else none
  | .release a => if ReleasePre s a then some (releaseEff s a) else none
  | .transfer src dst => if TransferPre k s src dst then some (transferEff s src dst) else none
  | .depend q x => if DependPre s q x then some (dependEff s q x) else none
  | .enter ps ls => if EnterPre s ps ls then some (enterEff s ps ls) else none
  | .exit => if ExitPre k s then some (exitEff s) else none
  | .read a ls => if canRead3 s a ls then some s else none
  | .write a ls => if canWrite3 s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .writeShared a ls => if WriteSharedPre k s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .pin p => if PinPre s p then some (pinEff s p true) else none
  | .unpin p => if UnpinPre k s p then some (pinEff s p false) else none
  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
    if AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none
  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
  | .issue i via region dst =>
    match s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar =>
      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
      else none
    | none => none
  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
  | _ => none

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of the extended machine, `none` otherwise. -/
def pexec (ps : PS) : Op → Option PS
  | .newPool st i => if NewPoolPre ps.s st i then some (newPoolEff ps st i) else none
  | .allocSlot j via dst =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      if AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst then
        match firstFree pl with
        | some i => (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst
        | none => none
      else none
    | none => none
  | .resolve j h m =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
      | some sl =>
        if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ HandleOK pl h ∧
            DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m then
          some { ps with
            s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
            res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
              [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] }
        else none
      | none => none
    | none => none
  | .resolveMany j hs m =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
          SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
            (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) then
        some { ps with
          s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
          res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
            batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] }
      else none
    | none => none
  | .unresolve c =>
    match findRes ps c with
    | some r => (releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp])).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }
    | none => none
  | .freeSlot j via h =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
      | some sl =>
        if PoolRight k ps.s pl via ∧ HandleCur pl h ∧ ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place ∧
            EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place then
          some (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl)
        else none
      | none => none
    | none => none
  | o => (kexec k ps.s o).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }

/-- Runs a list of operations; `some` of the final state when every step is `ok`. -/
def prun (ps : PS) : List Op → Option PS
  | [] => some ps
  | o :: os => (pexec k ps o).bind fun ps' => prun ps' os

end Exec

section ExecSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

theorem kexec_step {s s' : S3} {o : Op} (h : kexec k s o = some s') : Step k s s' := by

    | (split at h
       · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
         first

/-! ## `newPool storage internal` (material §4) -/

/-- Preconditions of `newPool storage internal` (material §4: "préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2,
J1)"): those of `newArena` (MM-03.3 §6, O17), read literally, so clause 4 speaks of the arenas of
the state. -/
def NewPoolPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop := NewArenaPre s storage internal

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewPoolPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewPoolPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newPool storage internal` (material §4): a pool with a fresh identity, one free
entry of generation 0 per child of the storage (the entries are the parts of `storage`, report (f)),
and the kernel state unchanged. -/
def newPoolEff (ps : PS) (storage internal : Nat) : PS :=
  { ps with
    pools := ps.pools ++ [⟨ps.nId, storage, internal,
      (kids ps.s.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
    nId := ps.nId + 1 }

/-- `newPool storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (material §4). -/
def NewPoolStep (storage internal : Nat) (ps : PS) : Outcome3 PS → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewPoolPre ps.s storage internal) (newPoolEff ps storage internal)

/-! ## `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4) -/

/-- First free entry of a list of slots, counted from `i`. -/
def firstFreeF : Nat → List Slot → Option Nat
  | _, [] => none
  | i, sl :: l => if sl.live then firstFreeF (i + 1) l else some i

/-- First free entry of a pool (report (f): the material does not say which free entry). -/
def firstFree (pl : Pool) : Option Nat := firstFreeF 0 pl.slots

/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4): the right to update the pool value;
`dst` a usable leaf, not `Init`, holding no active authority, under exercisable `Modify`. The size
of a handle is not represented: MM-03 has no sizes (report (f)). -/
def AllocSlotStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  PoolRight k s pl via ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
      True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (AllocSlotStatic k s pl via dst) := by
  unfold AllocSlotStatic; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the entry becomes live,
its content stays as it is, the handle is written into `dst`, which alone becomes `Init`. -/
def allocSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PS :=
  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) with s := write3Eff ps.s [dst] }

/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` into its destination (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`). -/
def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩

/-- `allocSlot pool dst : ok | fail | reject` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when a static
precondition fails or the pool does not exist; `fail`, state unchanged, when no entry is free;
`ok` otherwise, on the first free entry. -/
inductive AllocSlotStep (k : K) (j via dst : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl →
      AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst → firstFree pl = some i → pl.slots[i]? = some sl →
      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok (allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst))
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
      firstFree pl = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject

/-! ## `resolve h m` and `resolveMany hs m` (material §4) -/

/-- The handle designates a live entry of the pool, at its generation (material §4, `resolve`:
`fail` "si `h.id` n'est pas l'identité du pool, si `h.gen` diffère de la génération de l'entrée,
ou si l'entrée est libre"). A slot index outside the pool designates no entry (report (f)). -/
def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False

instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance

/-- Right of the pool value to exercise `internal` at mode `m` (material §4, `resolve`): the
precondition of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1) of the companion, from `internal`, on the whole storage.
It reads the effective mode of `internal`, so an active `Modify` companion rejects every new
resolution, whatever the handles (material §4, H31a). -/
def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop := DerivePre s pl.internal pl.storage m

instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance

/-- State after the compound borrow of one entry (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`,
derived from `internal` on the storage, then the entry authority `s.A.length + 1`, derived from the
companion on the place `q` of the entry, both at mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
def resolveS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length q m

/-- `resolve h m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when
the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged, when the handle is stale, of another pool or names
a free entry; `ok` with the compound borrow, recorded with the resolved generation. The derive of
the entry is a kernel step: its precondition is checked (`noEntry`). -/
inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → HandleOK pl h →
      pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →

instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (EntryBorrowed s pl q) := by
  unfold EntryBorrowed; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the end of the content of
the entry by `endUse` (MM-03.3 §3, O12), then the entry is free and its generation incremented. -/
def freeSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PS :=
  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) with
    s := endUseEff ps.s sl.place }

/-- `freeSlot h : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4), in order:
`reject` without the right to update the pool value; `fail`, state unchanged, for a stale handle
or one of another pool; `reject` when an active authority derived from `internal` covers the
entry; `reject` when a precondition of `endUse` fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive FreeSlotStep (k : K) (j via : Nat) (h : Handle) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl))
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via → ¬ HandleCur pl h →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | borrowed {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | endUse {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      ¬ EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject

inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- Structural disjointness (MM-03.3.2): neither path is a part of the other. -/
def structurallyDisjoint (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ¬ partOf P p q ∧ ¬ partOf P q p

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (structurallyDisjoint P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

/-! ## State `S3` (MM-03.3 §1) -/

/-- Initialisation state of a leaf (MM-03.3.3). -/

/-- Current frame: the head of the stack (MM-03.3.1). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value: `P y` for `some y`, `d` for `none`. -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
  match o with
  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- The holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (J1): a place, part of `src`, becomes the
corresponding part of `dst` (`corr`, `dst` itself for `src`). Applied to the holders within the
value only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5; J1): every leaf of the
destination becomes `Init`, every leaf of the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited
ones included, join those of the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority
held by a part of the source (the source included) is now held by the corresponding part of the
destination (A4, J1); every place owned by a part of the source is now owned by the corresponding
part of the destination, without moving, and its root follows (A5, J1, `RootHeld`). -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination leaf; that leaf, and it only, becomes `Init` (J1, second
bullet), so the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged unless the destination is one of its
leaves (`issue_into_arena_value`; J1, third bullet: a question of the pass-8 report); the region
leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value; J1: `dst` is a leaf
(`isLeaf`) that holds no active authority. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧
  isLeaf s.P dst ∧

inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (MM-03.3.2: `Place { id, parent?, frame, kind }`). Its identity is its index
in `P`. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.2 is generalised by `owner` (A5): a place is owned by a
frame or by another place (owned storage). A part has the owner of its parent (`WF3`). `kind`
is not interpreted: MM-03.3.2 gives no values for it. -/
structure Place where
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1): `storage` is the place of the administered storage;
`internal` is the authority that administers it, named by `newArena` (F1); `available` and
`issued` are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block.
The arena value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (F1), which follows
transfers (A4). The anchor of §6 is not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
structure Arena where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
`newArena` (D3). `callParams f`: the parameters given to frame `f` by `enterFrame`, a ghost record
(F6): set by `enterFrame`, never modified, read by no operation. -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  freed : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool
  arenas : List Arena
  callParams : Nat → List Nat


instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a`, empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Appends an authority to `A`: its identity is `s.A.length`. -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (MM-03.3.6: a containing value
inherits the dependencies of the contained values). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h10p ++ [.endUse 1, .release 3])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- H11: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, values `v1` (2) and `v2` (3); storage 4 with the
leaves 5 and 6, owned by 0, `internal` 4; blocks 5 on `[5]` to `v1` and 6 on `[6]` to `v2`; `v1`
is transferred into the leaf 6 of the block of `v2`. -/
def h11p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4,
  .issue 0 0 [5] 2, .issue 0 0 [6] 3, .transfer 2 6]
def h11 : PS := run K0 [] h11p

/-- **H11** (B; usage, A10; Lib). An arena buffer stored into another block of the same arena: the
`transfer` is accepted, `reset` is rejected while a block lives. Expected: `transfer` `ok`, `reset`
reject; obtained: the same. Twin: after the end of both blocks (`endUse` of `v2`, then of the leaf
6), `reset` is accepted. -/
theorem H11 : PReach K0 [] h11 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 h11.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0])) :=

def h12p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 2 [2], .derive 0 0 .observe,
  .store 3 1]

arena on 4; block 5 on `[5]` issued to 2; child arena on the leaf 5 with `internal` the block 5. -/
def h19p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1], .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 4, none, 0)],
  .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4, .issue 0 0 [5] 2, .newArena 5 5]
def h19 : PS := run K0 [] h19p

/-- **H19** (D; F1; Lib; covered pass 6). `reset` of the parent while the child lives: rejected;
after `endUse` of the child value 2: accepted. Expected: reject, then `ok`; obtained: the same. -/
theorem H19 : PReach K0 [] h19 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 h19.s .reject ∧

`issue` of the same region: every step `ok`. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H36 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] h36o) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H37: frame 1, result 0, allocator 1 written; it passes 2 (`Modify` on 0) and 3 (`Modify` on 1);
the callee allocates the storage 3 (leaf 4) owned by its arena value 2, of root 5, creates the arena,
transfers its value to the result and exits. -/
def h37o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 1 [1], .derive 0 0 .modify, .derive 1 1 .modify,
  .enter [2, 3] [lf], .alloc 1 2 [lf, (some 3, none, 0)], .write 4 [2], .newArena 3 5,
  .transfer 2 0, .exit]

/-- **H37** (H; A5; Lib; covered pass 2). An arena created by the callee on a storage allocated for

/-- W2: frame 1, allocator 0, owners 1 and 2 of two archetypes, entity pool value 3, handle leaves
4, 5, 6. Archetype 7 (columns 8 with 9, 10 and 11 with 12, 13) owned by 1; archetype 14 (columns
15 with 16, 17 and 18 with 19, 20) owned by 2; entity storage 21 (entries 22, 23, 24) owned by 3,
pool on it. `split` of the archetype into the columns (10 and 11), the second written, a read view
12 on it; system A writes the first column while system B reads through the view; `resolveMany
Modify` of three distinct entities. -/
def w2o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .write 2 [2], .write 3 [3],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 7, none, 0), (some 8, none, 0), (some 8, none, 0), (some 7, none, 0),
    (some 11, none, 0), (some 11, none, 0)],
  .alloc 0 2 [lf, (some 14, none, 0), (some 15, none, 0), (some 15, none, 0), (some 14, none, 0),
    (some 18, none, 0), (some 18, none, 0)],
  .alloc 0 3 [lf, (some 21, none, 0), (some 21, none, 0), (some 21, none, 0)], .newPool 21 9,
  .allocSlot 0 0 4, .allocSlot 0 0 5, .allocSlot 0 0 6,
  .split 7 [[9, 10], [12, 13]], .write 11 [12, 13], .derive 11 11 .observe,
  .write 10 [9, 10], .read 12 [12, 13], .resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 0⟩] .modify]
def w2 : PS := run K0 [] w2o
def w2a : PS := run K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12])

/-- **W2** (§5b, ECS archetype and sparse set; Lib). Disjoint reads and writes `ok`;
`resolveMany` `ok`; the move of a field of the row while the column view is active: rejected; after
the release of the views: `ok`. Expected: the same. Obtained: the same, reading "the view of the
column" as the column authority given by `split` (report, (f)): after the release of the read view
12 alone, the move is still rejected by the column authority 11 (O4.4); after its release, and that
of the first column authority, both fields of the row move. -/
theorem W2 : PReach K0 [] w2 ∧ TransferStep K0 12 19 w2.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] w2a ∧
    TransferStep K0 12 19 w2a.s .reject ∧ ActiveDerivedOutside w2a.s 12 11 ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .release 10, .transfer 9 16,
      .transfer 12 19])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .reject (by decide), by decide, run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- W3, literal reading: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, block values 2, 3, 4, structure 5
with the fields 6, 7, 8; storage 9 (leaves 10, 11, 12) owned by 0, `internal` 6; three blocks
issued to 2, 3, 4; three views (10, 11, 12), `Observe` on the blocks, stored into the fields. -/
def w3o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0),
    (some 5, none, 0)], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 9, none, 0), (some 9, none, 0), (some 9, none, 0)], .write 0 [0],
  .newArena 9 6, .issue 0 0 [10] 2, .issue 0 0 [11] 3, .issue 0 0 [12] 4,
  .derive 7 10 .observe, .derive 8 11 .observe, .derive 9 12 .observe, .store 10 6, .store 11 7,
  .store 12 8]
def w3 : PS := run K0 [] w3o
def w3e : PS := run K0 [] (w3o ++ [.endUse 5])
/-- W3, reading where the blocks are issued into the fields of the structure 2 (fields 3, 4, 5;
storage 6 with the leaves 7, 8, 9, `internal` 3). -/
def w3vo : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, (some 2, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),
    (some 2, none, 0)], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 6, none, 0), (some 6, none, 0), (some 6, none, 0)], .write 0 [0],
  .newArena 6 3, .issue 0 0 [7] 3, .issue 0 0 [8] 4, .issue 0 0 [9] 5]

/-- **W3** (§5b, frame arena; Lib). Expected: `reset` while the views live: reject; after `endUse`
of the structure: `ok`; reissue `ok`. Obtained, literal reading (report, (b)): reject while the
views live; after `endUse` of the structure, `reset` is still rejected, the three blocks being held
by the values 2, 3, 4 (MM-03.3 §6, O19.2); after their end, `reset` and the reissue are accepted.
With the blocks issued into the fields of the structure, the expected verdicts are obtained. -/
theorem W3 : PReach K0 [] w3 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 w3.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] w3e ∧
    ResetAtStep K0 0 0 w3e.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0,
      .issue 0 0 [10] 2])) ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] w3vo) ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 (run K0 [] w3vo).s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (w3vo ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [7] 3])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- Contracts with the place 3 deallocable by the authority 7. -/

section Run
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]

step is not `ok` (then `run_reach` cannot be used). -/

**Verdict: changes.** The verdicts of the option decisions themselves hold. What needs changing is the cost measure, which is the one that decides between the options: under §5's "Critère de choix", both options have no false rejection, so the less costly one wins. Its witness is outside the domain where option 3 is ever consulted, and the meaning of "local" was chosen without being flagged. There are also two docstring errors.

**F1 — medium. `formal/Ern/MM03/LockOptions.lean:247-256` (`opt3_not_local`). Cause: formalization error (witness outside the domain).**
- The witness state `h48` is one where the kernel already rejects `store 8 6`. `Horrors.lean` H48 proves `StoreStep 8 6 h48.s .reject`, and scratch `#eval (pexec K0 h48 (.store 8 6)).isSome` gives `false`.
- `decisions` (LockOptions.lean:129-131) consults an option only on kernel-`ok` steps. So on `h48`, option 3 never decides. Its `false` there adds nothing to the kernel's own G2 rejection, and the "different verdicts" cannot be credited to option 3.
- A pair where the kernel accepts the step in both states does exist, so the conclusion survives but is not what the theorem proves:
  - `u := run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])`
  - `ut := run K0 [] (fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .derive 5 5 .modify, .derive 7 6 .modify])`
  - Scratch results: both runs `prun … isSome = true`; `pexec K0 _ (.store 8 6)` is `some` for both; `u.s.A[8]? = ut.s.A[8]?` and `u.s.P = ut.s.P` both decide `true`; lengths are 10 and 10; `(opt3 u (.store 8 6), opt3 ut (.store 8 6)) = (false, true)`.

**F2 — high. `LockOptions.lean:18-20`, `:208-237`, `:247-256`. Cause: an ambiguous spec point resolved without saying so.**
- §5 asks: "la vérification est-elle locale à une fonction, ou exige-t-elle une analyse globale ?". The module measures something else: whether the check is local to the *operation*. Its docstring says "decided from the authorities the operation moves … option 3 is not, the decision depends on authorities the operation does not touch". Neither the commit message nor the docstrings flag this as a reading.
- The non-locality witness never leaves one function:
  - `#eval (h48.s.F, h48t.s.F)` gives `([1, 0], [1, 0])`.
  - The authority 7 that differs is held by `place 5` in one state and `frame 1` in the other, both inside frame 1.
  - So the witness shows option 3 depends on authorities the step does not touch. It does not show that option 3 needs analysis beyond a function.
- `opt2_transfer_local` assumes `hP : s'.P = s.P`, the whole place list across all frames. So it does not show option 2 can be decided from one function's data either. The module docstring's "the places that receive them" also claims more than the lemma's "same places".
- Per AGENTS.md this should be reported as an interpretation, or the witnesses should differ across frames.

**F3 — low. `LockOptions.lean:179-181` (`H49_options` docstring). Cause: formalization error (doc).**
- The docstring says option 3 rejects "the 7th checked step".
- `h49o` has 4 checked steps (two `issue`, `store 7 5`, `store 8 6`). The statement itself gives `dec3 h49o = [true, true, true, false]`, and scratch `#eval (dec3 h49o).length` gives `4`. The rejection is the 4th.

**F4 — low. `LockOptions.lean:198-200` (`H51_options` docstring). Cause: formalization error (doc, wrong reason).**
- The docstring says "option 2 does not check `store`, so the blocking remains". The real reason is different: even if option 2 checked `store`, the stored view is not self-locked.
  - `decide (SelfLock (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4)` gives `false`.
  - H51 is the 2-cycle 2↔4 (proved in the same theorem), which §5 says option 2 does not cover: "Ne couvre pas les cycles de longueur ≥ 2".
- The `true` decision for option 2 is right; only the stated reason is wrong.

**Checked and found sound (no finding):**
- **Runs are complete.** `mustAccept_runs` decides; `decisions` and `prun` both use `pexec K0` from `PS.init []`, so every checked step is measured.
- **Step counts match the scenarios:**
  - H11: 3 (issue, issue, transfer)
  - H45: 4
  - W2: the 2 transfers after the releases
  - W3: 7
  - W3v: 4
  - H29b, H37, H44, H46, H47: 1 each
- **Empty decision lists are correct, not a defect.** H35, H36 and W1 contain no `transfer`, `issue` or `store`. The pool operations are built on `derive`, `write` and `endUse` and hold their authorities by the frame (`HandlePool.lean` `resolveS`, `allocSlotEff`, `freeSlotEff`). §5 checks only those three operations.
- **Arrival states match `kexec`:** `transferEff`, `arenaSet (issueEff …).1 i (issueEff …).2`, `storeEff`. Option 2 on `issue` omits `arenaSet`, which `SelfLock` does not read.
- **The `active` conjunct in `SelfLock` and `Blocks` does not weaken them.** The flag is only ever set to `false` (MM03.lean, all `active := …` sites), and `derive` leaves the source active. `H49_cycle` confirms 7 is still active with helper 9.
- **`Opt2Transfer` checks the right authorities.** It covers exactly the authorities `transferEff` moves (`heldIn s.P src`), and `transferEff` does not change parent links, so footprints are unchanged.
- **Leaving `store` to O8.3 is exact.** `StorePre` forbids `a` covering a leaf of `p`, and `store` moves only `a`.
- **`BlocksAcyclic` misses no cycle.** It follows paths of length 1 to A.length+1, and every simple cycle has length at most A.length. Self-loops are excluded by `b ≠ a` and handled by the separate self-lock clause, as the brief says.
- **H49–H51 claims hold:**
  - `H49_cycle`, `H50_options` and `H51_options` decide as stated.
  - Option 3 is not over-credited on H49: the cycle exists at the arrival of the store, not only after the `release`.
  - The `Horrors` changes only give names to existing lists; no statement changed (diff compared).
- **Build checks pass:** `lake build` succeeds, the forbidden-term grep prints nothing, and `#print axioms` shows only `[propext, Quot.sound]` for `opt3_not_local`, `opt2_transfer_local`, `H49_options` and `no_false_rejection`.

Not checked: whether a cycle can involve authorities held in different frames. That is the witness F2 would need; I did not try to build it. Scratch files are under `/var/folders/fx/7gtkr7tx4wdc6t84nz4d15r40000gn/T/` (mktemp); no repository files were edited.
